reviewer: camera2_feature_join subagent; independent annotation pass, not an independent human expert
scope: Visual source-feature join only. No trajectory, timing alignment, acceleration, structural-cause, or whole-building-symmetry inference.

independence.first_pass_basis: Full printed/PDF page 13, full extracted Figure 4 raster, full native PNGs 6593 and 6841; selection metadata read only for identity. No overlays, cropped native panels, interpolation, or fresh video decode.

coordinate_convention.centers: Integer visual estimates of existing visible features, not subpixel measurements or recovered Tracker coordinates.
coordinate_convention.bounds: Inclusive subjective [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] boxes; localization judgment only, not confidence intervals or validated errors.
coordinate_convention.regions: A region is a search/ambiguity area, not an accepted point. Its midpoint must not be used as a measured coordinate.

paper.geometry_authentication: The caption assigns the cardinal labels. This review has not authenticated camera location, building orientation, or architectural identity from an independent geometry source.

paper_frame_join.native_source_frame_status: Not established. Similar roof configuration, camera view, smoke, image crop, or timing guesses do not prove a frame identity.
paper_frame_join.baseline_relation: Fixed native frame 6593 is a comparison baseline only. It does not authenticate the paper raster, the camera's history, or the Figure 4 source frame.
paper_frame_join.visual_relation: Corresponding background arrangement, facade form, lower roofline and raised rooftop structure support a qualitative feature-neighborhood comparison; no numeric image registration was performed.
paper_frame_join.paper_markers_as_measurements: The colored rings/crosses indicate source-assigned neighborhoods. They overwrite source pixels and do not disclose the exact Tracker selection or prove that a ring center is the tracked material point.

features.source_marker_relation: Left end of the lower roofline, below/left of the surviving raised rooftop feature. Smoke and the overlaid marker prevent a secure material-corner identification.
features.native_feature_description: Smoke-softened left end of the visible main facade/lower roofline, not the higher left rooftop silhouette.

observations.reason: Smoke and overlying/adjacent rooftop structure obscure a unique meeting of the lower roofline and a material vertical facade edge. The upper silhouette is visible but would substitute a different feature.
A lower roofline segment emerges toward the raised structure, but its left endpoint is smoke-softened and does not securely resolve a material corner. No unique point accepted.

features.join_strength: D: source label is clear; native exact material-point identity is underdetermined.

features.native_feature_description: Apparent intersection of lower roofline with the left vertical side of the surviving raised rooftop structure; a projected edge junction, not yet authenticated as a physical material connection.

observations.reason: The higher rooftop silhouette continues across this area; the lower left step-foot shown in Figure 4 is not distinctly exposed. A dark facade strip or assumed continuation would not supply an independently identified point.
Lower horizontal roofline meets the short left rise to the higher rooftop silhouette. Blur/smoke and possible superposition limit exact localization and material identity.

features.join_strength: C for the visible projected junction at 6841; D at 6593. This does not validate a persistent material track.

features.source_marker_relation: Lower right foot of the raised rooftop step. The light-blue west-penthouse marker is above it on the step's upper edge; those are distinct features.
features.native_feature_description: Right step-foot where the short drop from the higher rooftop silhouette meets the lower roofline extending to the outer right corner. A visible projected junction; its physical construction is not authenticated here.

observations.reason: Lower foot of the right rooftop drop is visible. The upper corner near y144-146 is not the accepted WC feature.
Lower foot of the right rooftop drop is visible; preserve uncertainty due to raster blur and edge thickness.

features.join_strength: B for qualitative projected-junction correspondence; C for exact material identity and localization. Equal integer estimates are not a finding of zero motion.

features.source_marker_relation: Outer right corner of the lower roofline, where its top edge meets the bright right vertical facade boundary.
features.native_feature_description: Visible outer right facade/roofline corner. This is the strongest material-corner candidate in the fixed frames, although the source's cardinal designation is not independently authenticated.

observations.reason: Lower roofline and right facade edge form a readily identifiable outer corner; image blur produces a several-pixel boundary.
Same qualitative outer-corner configuration is visible. Equal integer estimates are not a finding of zero motion.

features.join_strength: B for qualitative outer-corner correspondence; C for exact material-point localization.

disconfirming_checks: Frame 6593 lacks a clearly exposed EC lower-left step-foot; a visual-join claim applying an unqualified EC point to both fixed frames would exceed this pass.

A roofline meeting the projection of a screen-wall or penthouse side can be a silhouette/occlusion junction rather than one material point. An authenticated drawing/view and Tracker project could change that assessment.
A ring enclosing a useful feature does not establish that the authors tracked that exact feature or ring center.
Different apparent scale/crop/color and similar background arrangement do not establish a native frame number for the paper raster.
